description: 听不懂不可怕，停在那里才尴尬。练熟这几句，任何场合都能自然地把节奏拉回来。

targetChunks.en: Sorry, could you say that again?
targetChunks.zh: 不好意思，能再说一遍吗？
targetChunks.note: 最通用的一句。sorry 开头，语气缓，不会让人觉得你不耐烦。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — The meeting moved to Thursday. — Sorry, could you say that again?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——会议改到周四了。——不好意思，能再说一遍吗？

targetChunks.note: catch 在这里是“听清、听懂”。比 I don't understand 轻很多。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — It's on the second floor. — Sorry, I didn't catch that.

targetChunks.en: Could you speak a little slower, please?
targetChunks.note: a little 比 very slowly 更礼貌，对方更容易接受。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Could you speak a little slower, please? I'm still learning.

targetChunks.note: 听清单词但不明白意思时用。也可以问 What do you mean by that?
targetChunks.exampleEn: — We'll need a deposit. — What does that mean, exactly?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——我们需要付定金。——具体是什么意思？

targetChunks.note: 听人名、地名、邮箱时特别有用。拼写比发音可靠。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — My name is Siobhan. — Sorry, how do you spell that?

targetChunks.note: 手里拿着东西、指着屏幕时用，比说一长串描述快。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — The blue form. — Do you mean this one?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——蓝色的那张表。——你是指这个吗？

targetChunks.note: 先说这句，对方通常会主动放慢、换简单说法，比自己硬撑好。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Sorry, my English isn't great. Could you write it down?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——抱歉，我英语不太好。能写下来吗？

targetChunks.note: 数字、地址、名字听不准时，写下来最快。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — It's four nine two... — Sorry, could you write it down?

targetChunks.en: Let me make sure I got that right.
targetChunks.zh: 我确认一下，我没听错的话……
targetChunks.note: 用自己的话重复一遍之前先垫这句，非常自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Let me make sure I got that right. You want it delivered on Friday?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——我确认一下，你是想周五送到吗？

targetChunks.note: 很短，熟人间或服务柜台前都自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — Gate B twelve. — One more time, please?

targetChunks.note: follow 是“跟上思路”，比 I don't understand 柔和，适合对方在讲解时。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — So we reverse the order... — Sorry, I'm not sure I follow.
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——所以我们把顺序反过来……——抱歉，我没太跟上。

targetChunks.en: Could you explain that in another way?
targetChunks.zh: 能换个说法解释一下吗？
targetChunks.note: 不是要求重复，而是要求换表达。对方听不懂你的中文思维时很有用。
targetChunks.exampleEn: — It's a co-pay. — Could you explain that in another way?
targetChunks.exampleZh: ——这是共付额。——能换个说法解释一下吗？

roleplay.promptZh: 在柜台办业务，对方说得又快又长。你要请对方重复、放慢、换个说法，最后确认自己理解正确。
roleplay.promptEn: At a service counter, the staff speaks fast. Ask them to repeat, slow down, and confirm what you heard.
goals: 用 Sorry, could you... 打断并请求重复
请对方放慢或换一种说法
最后用自己的话复述确认

script.speaker: other
script.en: So your membership expires on the fifteenth, and renewal is forty-nine ninety a year.
script.zh: 你的会员 15 号到期，续费是一年 49.9。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Sorry, could you say that again? I didn't catch the date.
script.zh: 不好意思，能再说一遍吗？我没听清日期。

script.speaker: other
script.en: The fifteenth. Your membership expires on the fifteenth.
script.zh: 15 号，你的会员 15 号到期。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Got it. And how much is the renewal?

script.speaker: you
script.en: Sorry, could you write that down? I want to make sure I got it right.
script.zh: 不好意思，能写下来吗？我想确认一下。

script.speaker: you
script.en: Thanks. So just to confirm, it's forty-nine ninety for one year?
script.zh: 谢谢。确认一下，是一年 49.9 对吗？
